# Interpolate

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A grid of points valued by inverse-distance weighting of a column of the input points, as turf.interpolate. Runs turf in the engine.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "interpolate", "name": "interpolate", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:cellSize`, or read elsewhere as `ch('interpolate/cellSize')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `property` | `column` | `"value"` |  |
| `cellSize` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `units` | `menu` | `"kilometers"` | `kilometers`, `meters`, `miles`, `nauticalmiles`, `feet`, `degrees` |
| `weight` | `float` | `2` |  |
| `gridType` | `menu` | `"point"` | `point`, `square`, `hex`, `triangle` |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

|------|------|

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
